summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025 Academic Month Practical: 15 Years of Transforming Digital Design ## Introduction I am very honored to participate in this online academic seminar. I will share with you how I transformed from a traditional fashion designer to a 3D digital fashion designer. Today's presentation will explain from a technical point of view what kind of technical skills we need to support different application products. When Mr. Ma was speaking just now, I noticed that some students were concerned about a specific issue: What software do we need to use when creating digital works? Today, I will simply share with you the essential software we need to master according to different projects and skill levels. Through this introduction, I hope to help you establish a concept of digital fashion, including the work effects you want to achieve in the future and the direction in which you should work. ## Personal Background First of all, let me briefly introduce myself. My name is Liu Wanping. I graduated from Dalian University of Art and Design in 2005. I have been involved in the design and development of fashion products in the clothing industry since 2018. In 2018, I started to get in touch with Cloud3D, which initiated my technical transformation. Currently, I run my own 3D fashion design studio, focusing on modeling and modeling services for enterprises, including universities and companies. I also participate in 3D courses and provide training to enterprises. Additionally, I share some of my daily skills and experiences using software on platforms like Xiaohongshu and Bilibili to help those who want to enter this industry grow quickly. ## Journey of Transformation Since 2018, I have transformed from a traditional designer to a digital fashion designer. Initially, I was responsible for the design and development of the entire product. However, I faced challenges such as high costs and low efficiency in product design and development, which made it difficult to adapt to the fast-changing market. This prompted me to seek solutions, leading me to Cloud3D and the transformation of my design skills. ### Timeline of Involvement From 2018 to 2025, I have participated in various projects utilizing 3D fashion technology. These projects cover the entire industry chain, from traditional fashion design to marketing and virtual fashion displays for customers. In the upper half of this timeline, you can see projects I collaborated on, such as 3D modeling for the Beijing Contemporary Art Museum, showcasing conceptual costumes, and selling digital products on Xiaohongshu alongside my own IP designs at the Yuan Yizhou exhibition. ## Evolving Role of Designers For those aspiring to work in the fashion industry, whether as traditional designers or digital fashion designers, the dynamics of collaboration have changed. With digital advancements, designers no longer need to be restricted to a specific platform or geographical location for collaboration. Mastering digital tools allows for more creative freedom, transcending the limitations of physical materials. ## Levels of Capability Today, I want to express how I have divided necessary skills into three levels of capability: ### Level 1: Basic Proficiency At this level, entering the fashion industry for design, production, or sales requires mastery of Cloud3D to produce virtual samples that enhance the efficiency of the design and development process. Mastery of this software alone can meet daily work needs. ### Level 2: Intermediate Application As work scope expands into clothing sales, designers need to present virtual services to sales teams and end customers. This requires stronger operational skills in software. Knowledge of additional tools like Blender, Maya, and traditional 3D modeling software becomes essential. For high-end fabric presentations, knowledge of scanning equipment and software like Substance 3D is also necessary. ### Level 3: Advanced Creative Production For applications in digital art, advertising, and marketing, greater proficiency in 3D software is required, alongside AI technology to assist in generating videos and character animations efficiently. ## Employment Directions As I transitioned from traditional design and research in the clothing industry to the digital realm, my employment options broadened. Mastering various 3D modeling software and AI drawing technology opens doors for cross-industry collaborations, including advertising, marketing, and CG gaming. ## Case Studies and Practical Applications To illustrate the work achievable at different capability levels, I will provide specific examples. ### Example 1: Digital Sample Production During the pandemic, I created digital samples for clients, reducing the time and material costs of production. By utilizing Cloud3D, the entire design process became paperless, allowing for immediate simulation of clothing effects and enabling client pre-sales based on digital models. ### Example 2: E-commerce Simulation In collaboration with Xinyu Productions, I created 3D simulations of clothing for e-commerce without the need for physical samples. This approach allowed for material changes and style testing based on consumer feedback, ultimately predicting production quantities more accurately. ## Conclusion In summary, mastering software like Cloud3D significantly enhances the efficiency of design processes and facilitates communication among team members. This digital transformation not only streamlines workflows but also allows designers to focus more on creativity and less on logistical challenges. Thank you for your attention, and I hope this presentation has provided valuable insights into the future of digital fashion design. ```
